svg.title: Blockade Runner (240t) - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 88-89, PDF 89-90. Combined two-deck plan envelope retains flat narrow forebody and wide rear machinery shoulders with bevelled stern corners. Lower fuel deck is contained within main body. Illustration supports broad armoured aft body; fine illustrated rear fins omitted with span unspecified. Distinct from Adventure Class Ships Blockade Runner; existing matching asset preserved.
